name: Enchantment Enchainment
approach: From the Stuart Lake trailhead at the end of Eightmile Road, follow the Stuart Lake trail up Mountaineer Creek through old burn toward Stuart Lake. Beyond the lake leave the trail and climb the slopes toward Long Pass, then steep snow to the notch on Stuart's northwest face that gives the shortcut onto the upper West Ridge. The West Ridge is normally approached from the south, so this north-side access sees little traffic; expect snow in the notch and gully well into summer.
